title: Children Book Illustration: Cute Characters
description: Generate charming children book illustrations in MJ Niji 6. Cuteness + simplicity + warmth.

prompt.main: children book illustration, adorable baby dragon with big round eyes and soft purple scales, sitting in a magical forest, friendly small fox and bunny companions, soft watercolor style, warm pastel color palette with mint green, peach, and sky blue, hand-painted texture, gentle expression, full body, storybook illustration --niji 6 --ar 1:1 --s 400
prompt.negative: --no scary, dark, realistic, complex, scary teeth

explained.why: Niji handles cute, soft illustration styles better than v6.
Medium stylize — high enough to be charming, low enough to look hand-painted.
The single most important cuteness cue in children's illustration.

tutorial.intro: Children's book art lives on: cuteness cues + simple composition + warm palette. AI does all three.
steps: Character: adorable baby dragon with big round eyes and soft purple scales — specific creature + specific features.
Cuteness cues: big round eyes — non-negotiable for kids' books.
Companions: friendly small fox and bunny companions — adds story.
Setting: sitting in a magical forest — soft, safe atmosphere.
Style: soft watercolor style, warm pastel color palette with mint green, peach, and sky blue — children's book palette.
tutorial.tips: Big round eyes is the #1 cuteness multiplier. Always include it. Add "soft round shapes" to your prompt for extra cute.

crossModel.midjourney: Niji 6: use the rewrite prompt with --s 400.
crossModel.stable_diffusion:

faq.a: You forgot "soft scales" and "big round eyes". Add both — they push the dragon from "Smaug" to "toothpaste mascot".
MJ Niji 6 is the king. SDXL + Dreamshaper is also good.

faq.q: How to keep style consistent across pages?
faq.a: Use the same seed + similar prompt structure. Or use SDXL with style LoRAs.
